changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from ODK and FormShare records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Horse gram tricot trial in Sambalpur, Odisha, India, 2025
study.description: On-farm tricot trial on horse gram in Sambalpur, Odisha, India, in the 2025-2026 season. Each participant grew a package of three of 11 genotypes. Data were collected with ODK forms and stored in FormShare under project code BAIF25ODHG, in 3 moments (registration, after reproduction, post-harvest), and merged on the package number.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, interview point, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
First level administrative unit (state, province, region, department)
Second level administrative unit (district, municipality, county, woreda)
Lowest administrative unit recorded (village, community, kebele)
Gender of the participant
Age of the participant in years at registration
Planting date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Harvesting date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Does the participant usually grow this crop on the farm (yes, no)
Variety or varieties of the crop the participant normally grows, as given
Usual source of the participant's seed of the crop
Did the participant test a crop in the tricot trials of the previous year (yes, no)
Cultivable land of the participant in hectares (asked to participants new to the trials)
Why the participant liked the most preferred option most, free text as given (English, Marathi, Gujarati, Odia or Kannada)
Why the participant liked the least preferred option least, free text as given (English, Marathi, Gujarati, Odia or Kannada)
Crops the participant normally grows on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Fertilizers the participant applies on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Type of irrigation used on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Kind of tillage practised on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Water conservation practised on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Soil conservation practised on the farm (several answers separated by '; ')
Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date
Day the form of the collection moment was filled in or submitted for the site (YYYY-MM-DD), the actual date of the observation; null when the source has none or the form was typed in after the season
Variable name, harmonised across trials
Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
Unit of numeric values. Yield values refer to the entire plot
Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Disease resistance (least disease incidence is rank 1; the form asked which option had more and which had less disease)
Harvesting date of the option (YYYY-MM-DD)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Maturity (earliest maturity is best)
Number of rows planted with the option
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Overall preference
Performance compared with the local variety: Overall performance compared with the variety the participant currently grows
Number of plants harvested, as typed (the form asked for five sampled plants per option; some sites recorded more)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Plant height (tallest is rank 1)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Pod size (largest pods is rank 1)
Length of the centre row of the option
Grain weight of five sampled plants of the option (form question Yield of 5 plants), in grams; not the plot yield
